ios.desc:
Weather without the noise. At home and wherever you are headed.

HonestSky is a free weather app with no ads, tracking, subscriptions, or paywalls. Every feature is available to everyone.

PLAN FOR YOUR TRIP
Add a temporary trip with your destination, dates, activities, and travel mode. Get a forecast preview, packing suggestions, and guidance for watching or playing sports, outdoor events, sightseeing, hiking, golf, and more. See weather at your departure place and destination for both the outbound and return trip.

Opt in to server monitoring for meaningful changes to your trip forecast. View what changed and pause trip notifications until tomorrow. Monitoring ends after your return date. Trips stay separate from your saved cities.

WEATHER AT A GLANCE
- Current conditions, feels-like temperature, wind, humidity, UV, pressure, and visibility
- Hourly and daily forecasts with precipitation chances
- Animated past radar and a beta three-hour Futurecast for the contiguous US
- US National Weather Service and European MeteoAlarm alerts where available
- Air quality and weather maps
- Saved city forecasts that refresh together when you open the app
- Weather and travel widgets for iPhone, plus HonestSky for Apple Watch
- Light and dark themes, with English, French, and Spanish interfaces

PACK WITH CONFIDENCE
Use the weather-based packing checklist on any supported device. Compatible iPhones with Apple Intelligence enabled can also generate an optional on-device packing summary. The forecast and checklist work without Apple Intelligence.

YOUR PRIVACY
No accounts, advertising SDKs, or analytics SDKs. Forecast requests use rounded coordinates. Optional weather alerts store the push token and weather context needed to deliver them. Trip monitoring stores the trip details you choose to share. Delete server-side records from Settings. Newsletter signup is optional.

Forecast coverage depends on the location and date. Trip guidance uses weather at your trip endpoints; it does not include live flight status, train schedules, or conditions along a full driving route.

Weather sources include Open-Meteo, CAMS, NOAA/National Weather Service, MeteoAlarm, and the Iowa Environmental Mesonet. Source and license details are available in Settings.

show_hn.title: Show HN: HonestSky, a free iOS weather app without ads or subscriptions

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I’m Sean. I built HonestSky because I was tired of weather apps that were slow to load, covered in ads some to the point of being unusable and then putting longer forecasts behind paywalls.

I’ve been using it myself for over a year, and today I finally (finally finally) released it on the iOS App Store.

It includes hourly and extended forecasts, radar, severe weather alerts, and air quality. All features are free, with no ads or account required.

Privacy was another reason I wanted to build it. Reading about the location-data lawsuits involving weather apps made me uncomfortable with how a straightforward weather lookup could turn into something else. This is something I didn’t realize until after I was looking for how to get the word out.

You can save locations and opt into push notifications for weather alerts. It uses that information only to provide your forecasts and alerts. I don’t sell your data or use it for anything else.

The weather data comes from providers including Open-Meteo, RainViewer, and the National Weather Service.

This started as something I wanted for myself. After using it for a year, I figured other people might find it useful too. Plus it costs a few bucks to host and process so I put a donation bucket out there.. although Apple made me take any sort of asking for donations out of it so I haven’t figured that part out yet.

I’d appreciate feedback on the interface, the forecasts and alerts, and anything that would stop you from using it …
